title: platform-standup-2026-03-15
content:
Platform Engineering standup notes - 2026-03-15

Attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Sofia, Ethan, Priya (remote)
Time: 09:15 - 09:35 PT

Quick wins / updates
- Control Plane: deployed hotfix for config reconciliation (PLAT-482). Metrics look stable - reconciliation latency down ~35% on canary. Observability dashboard updated (trace + reconciliation_histogram).
- Routing: rolling rollout of weighted routing to canary region continued; no 5xx spikes in canary. Latency tail improvements observed for short requests (seq_len < 128).
- Auth: short-term mitigation for token expiry race is in place (PR merged, see PR 318). Need follow-up to add unit tests for refresh flow.
- Quotas: new quota enforcement path for embeddings jobs merged to staging. Throttling behaviour verified against synthetic load.

Blockers / Risks
- Control Plane: intermittent reconciliation loop where some customer configs flip-flop between versions A/B under race conditions (repro steps added to PLAT-497). Root cause suspected in controller backoff logic when ETCD watch reconnects. Marcus to own debug.
- Routing: one routing rule edge-case where model alias fallback doesn't respect region preference when capacity is low. Requires small change in matcher; estimated 2d.
- Auth: a customer reported sporadic 401s after long-lived connections when KMS rotates keys. Impact limited to dedicated customers using KMS rotation. Priya and SRE to coordinate on test harness.
- Quotas: quota enforcement for batch-embedding jobs currently counts tokens incorrectly for multi-part payloads; leads to undercounting. Sofia to add tests and fix counter aggregation.

Deep-dive notes
- Control Plane reconciliation (Aisha):
  - Canary rollout of reconciliation fix (PLAT-482) shows improvement, but race still reproducible in stress tests. Added more logging around version stamps and retry windows.
  - Next steps: add jitter to retry backoff and tighter invariants to accept only monotonically increasing version stamps. Timeline: Marcus + Aisha to implement changes and run e2e by EOD Friday.

- Routing (Marcus):
  - Weighted routing: experiments show 12% lower p95 for small requests when using new matcher. Need to confirm no regressions for long-running sessions.
  - Fallback logic bug: reproducer attached in PLAT-501. Plan to adjust matcher precedence order. Work blocked until PR review finished.

- Auth (Priya):
  - Token refresh race: root cause is concurrent refresh attempts invalidating refresh token cache. Short-term fix: in-memory singleflight for refresh per session deployed. Longer term: add resilience to refresh flow and expand integration tests with KMS rotations.
  - Action: Priya to open follow-up ticket for refresh telemetry and test coverage.

- Quotas (Sofia):
  - Batch-embedding counting: aggregation logic assumes single payload per request. Fix requires flattening multipart payloads before token counting.
  - Action: Sofia to push patch to staging and add broken-case regression tests.

Action items (owners + ETA)
- Marcus: investigate ETCD watch/reconnect backoff and implement jittered backoff for controller (ETA: 2026-03-18).
- Aisha + Marcus: end-to-end validation of reconciliation changes (ETA: 2026-03-19).
- Priya: coordinate with SRE to add KMS rotation test harness and expand tests for token refresh (ETA: 2026-03-22).
- Sofia: fix token counting for multipart batch embeddings and add regression tests (ETA: 2026-03-17).
- Ethan: review routing matcher PR and unblock weighted routing fallback change (ETA: 2026-03-16).

Incidents / Postmortem follow-ups
- Remember to add follow-ups from last week's incident (PLAT-470): update runbooks to include manual reconciliation steps and quorum checks. Marcus to add to runbook repository.

Notes / reminders
- Console: product asked for a visible flag for per-customer reconciliation status - short spec in Confluence, Aisha to sync with product next week.
- Performance: ops noticed an increase in reconciliation DB writes during peak; consider batching writes if CPU/ETCD pressure continues.
- Customer outreach: CS flagged two customers on Dedicated who saw transient 401s - coordinate customer comms after root cause verified.

Parking lot / future work
- Evaluate using an internal lease service for controller leadership to reduce ETCD watch chatter.
- Consider adding a small delayed de-duplication queue for routing match decisions to reduce oscillation during capacity changes.

Next standup
- Monday 2026-03-16 09:15 PT. Please update PR links and ticket statuses before the meeting.

Quick todos (notes to self)
- Add unit tests for token refresh path (Priya)
- Add stress test for reconciliation with multi-tenant configs (Marcus)
- Ensure quota counters are compatible with new batch API shape (Sofia)

End of notes.
